specification.target: Monte Carlo finite-job return-to-go on every active stochastic diagnostic row.
specification.comparison: Same starting critic, frozen normalized inputs, targets, minibatch orders, fresh Adam and update budget; only value clipping differs.
specification.scope: CPU regression diagnostic, not PPO training or an estimate of generalization; fitted models cannot initialize a policy run.

decision: Remove absolute value clipping only in a fresh registered PPO run. Retain actor clipping, architecture, reward, physical task, samples and optimizer budget. No fitted or partial weights reused.
scope_and_limitations: Fixed-data critic regression on 1383 correlated development states at equal 1200 updates per arm, not new PPO performance.
Removing clipping resolves the observed train-set fit bottleneck; generalization and policy competence remain unproven.
No extra simulator transitions. The source trajectories are fully charged in the four-arm partial diagnosis.
